definitions.explanation: Something designed to be folded for compact storage or transport. Used as a noun modifier to describe items that can be folded.

examples.japanese: {折|お}りたたみ{傘|がさ}を{持|も}っていく。
この{自転車|じてんしゃ}は{折|お}りたたみ{式|しき}なので、{電車|でんしゃ}にも{持|も}ち{込|こ}める。
examples.english: This bicycle is the folding type, so you can bring it on the train.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}が{狭|せま}いので、{使|つか}わないときは{折|お}りたたみのテーブルを{片付|かたづ}けている。
examples.english: Since my room is small, I put away the folding table when I'm not using it.

notes:
{折|お}りたたみ is derived from the verb {折|お}りたたむ (to fold up).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {折|お}りたたみ{傘|がさ}: folding umbrella
- {折|お}りたたみ{椅子|いす}: folding chair
- {折|お}りたたみ{式|しき}: folding type/style
- {折|お}りたたみ{自転車|じてんしゃ}: folding bicycle

USAGE:
Almost always used as a noun modifier before another noun. Rarely used on its own.
